_comment: SatarkSim parameters. Every value carries a provenance label: REAL (primary source read in this project), SECONDHAND (reported by press/search summary, primary not opened), FIT (derived from labelled inputs), ASSUMED (design choice with no source; covered by sensitivity sweeps). See docs/satarksim-provenance.md.

p2m.label: FIT
p2m.fit_to: mean Rs 589 (Worldline, SECONDHAND) and 86% of P2M under Rs 500 (SECONDHAND)

p2p.label: FIT
p2p.fit_to: mean ~Rs 2640 (derived from H1-2025 P2P volume/value, SECONDHAND) and 59% of P2P under Rs 500 (SECONDHAND)

population_mean_check_rupees.label: REAL
population_mean_check_rupees.source: NPCI Product Statistics UPI 2026-27 Monthly (user-supplied xlsx): value/volume

new_payee_prob.label: ASSUMED
new_payee_prob.note: no published new-payee rate was found

legit.label: ASSUMED
legit.note: hard-negative rates; no frequency data was found. Covered by sensitivity sweeps (hard_negative_scale).

playbook_mix.label: ASSUMED
playbook_mix.note: no official split by playbook was found

amount.label: ASSUMED
amount.note: UPI per-transaction limit Rs 1 lakh caps single transfers; digital-arrest losses reported as ~Rs 1.57 lakh mean per complaint (SECONDHAND, MHA 2024) arrive as several transfers

timing_minutes.label: ASSUMED
timing_minutes.note: No empirical gap data was found. Ranges deliberately straddle the OCSS design bounds (10/20/5 min) so the ordered flag does not always hold.

detector_constants.label: DESIGN (from implementation plan and architecture doc)
